buttons.css: .action-button { padding: 8px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; font: inherit; }
cards.css: .youtube-groups__subscription-control { display: inline-block; margin-left: 8px; max-width: 100%; vertical-align: middle; }
cards.css: ytd-video-renderer .youtube-groups__subscription-control, ytd-channel-renderer .youtube-groups__subscription-control { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-left: 0; margin-top: 4px; }
cards.css: .youtube-groups__subscription-control--compact { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; margin-left: 0; margin-top: 4px; font-size: 11px; }
cards.css: .youtube-groups__subscription-control--compact button { margin-left: 0; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.4; }
cards.css: .youtube-groups__card-glyph { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; margin-right: 4px; font-weight: 600; }

cards.css: .youtube-groups__subscription-control.youtube-groups__card-actions--overlay { position: absolute; top: 4px; left: 4px; z-index: 2; display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex-wrap: nowrap; align-items: flex-start; gap: 4px; margin: 0; max-width: none; }

cards.css: .youtube-groups__card-actions--overlay button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; box-sizing: border-box; height: 28px; margin: 0; padding: 0 7px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1; color: #ffffff; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7); border: 0; border-radius: 14px; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; }
cards.css: .youtube-groups__card-actions--overlay.youtube-groups__subscription-control--compact button { height: 22px; padding: 0 5px; font-size: 11px; color: #ffffff; }

cards.css: .youtube-groups__card-actions--overlay button:not(:disabled):hover, .youtube-groups__subscription-control--compact button:not(:disabled):hover, .youtube-groups__watched-button:not(:disabled):hover { color: var(--yg-accent-text, #ffffff); background: var(--yg-accent, #1a73e8); }

fullscreen.css: html:has(:fullscreen) #youtube-groups-menu, html:has(:fullscreen) .youtube-groups__subscription-dropdown, html:has(:fullscreen) .youtube-groups__playlist-dropdown, html:has(:fullscreen) .youtube-groups__icon-picker, html:has(:fullscreen) .youtube-groups__shorts-actions, html:has(:fullscreen) #youtube-groups-toast { display: none !important; }
